games.name: [The Lakehouse] Entry Point: Freelancer's Cut
games.desc:
The Freelancer's Cut is open for early access. Currently, five of the eight mission remakes are available in game, along with several community created levels.

This is a niche game with a lot of complexity and a steep learning curve. I highly recommend checking out the free demo first to see if this game is for you.
https://www.roblox.com/games/740581795/Entry-Point-Freelancers-Cut-Demo

Rejoin the criminal organization of Halcyon in this pack of remastered Entry Point missions. With new tactics, reworked skills, and expanded mission concepts, try your hand at running elaborate covert infiltrations - sneak, bluff, hack, or force your way through any way you can. There are only two rules: Get the job done and don't get caught doing it.

games.desc:
🧟 ROBONG SURVIVORS — co-op horde survival. Hundreds of zombies, ghosts and goblins at once. Your weapons fire on their own; you choose what they become.

⚔️ SEASON 3 IS LIVE

▸ THE RUN
Every level-up is a choice. Max a weapon, pair it with the right perk, and it EVOLVES.
Kill the Guardian and a portal opens: leave and bank your gems (+60%), or stay for the Chaos and risk the whole run.

Castle → City → Desert → Arena → Frozen. Clear one to unlock the next. Each ends in a boss.

▸ WHAT YOU KEEP
10 classes with a "Q" ability · pets to hatch, level and merge · skill tree · clans with quests and research · seasonal leaderboards and titles.

▸ 1-4 PLAYER CO-OP
Revive your team, vote at the portal, clear maps together.

🔄 UPDATED EVERY WEEK — report bugs on Discord.
🎁 CODES on our Discord · 👍 LIKE + JOIN THE GROUP for rewards.
